cases.title: RP-106b: outbound webhook subscription API is documented (OpenAPI)
Agents cannot list or register webhooks (403)
Admin registers an endpoint; the secret is returned once, reads show a hint only
Secret is encrypted at rest
SSRF / input checks: metadata, link-local, unspecified, non-http(s), credentials, bad events -> 422
Send test: delivered synchronously, signed with the secret, logged as a test delivery
contact.created reaches the receiver via the worker, signed, with event headers
contact.updated carries the changed field (from / to)
lead.created and lead.qualified (SQL) are delivered
deal.created, deal.stage_changed and deal.won are delivered
Events the endpoint is not subscribed to are not sent (contact.deleted)
A 500 answer is recorded and retried later (attempt 1 of 6, next attempt ~1 min)
The retry succeeds once the receiver recovers (same event id)
Redeliver queues the same event again and the worker sends it
After 20 consecutive failures the endpoint is switched off and admins are notified
A disabled endpoint receives nothing
Redirects are not followed (302 = failed delivery, target never called)
A receiver slower than 10 s times out (failed, request bounded)
Rotated secret: deliveries are signed with the new secret, not the old one
Another workspace gets 404 on every endpoint operation
Events of another workspace never reach this workspace's endpoint
Delivery log: newest first, bounded (limit<=100), status filter, payload on detail
Deleting an endpoint removes it and its delivery log
